entity_raw.definition_raw: Ambush SubdomainSource Kobolds of Golarion pg. 13Associated Domain(s): TrickeryAssociated Deities: Kro'akothReplacement Power: Note: Only creatures with the Kobold Faith trait can take this subdomain. The following granted power replaces the copycat power of the Trickery domain. Chameleon Aspect (Su): As a swift action, you can subtly alter the color of your scales, blending them with the surrounding environment. While under the effect of this power, you gain concealment from creatures more than 10 feet away (attacks have a 20% miss chance), and total concealment from creatures more than 40 feet away (attacks have a 50% miss chance). You can use this ability a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.Replacement Domain Spells: 1st—alarm, 5th—illusory wall, 6th—veil.
